usageNotes: Use this to create a new API token for a PDM user, either for automation accounts or to generate scoped tokens for your own account. The response includes the plaintext token secret exactly once — it cannot be retrieved again, so capture it immediately. Users can create tokens for themselves without elevated privileges; creating tokens for other users requires Access.Modify on /access/users.

examples.summary: Create a read-only automation token for the local admin user, expiring in ~1 year

tips: The full authentication ID (Authid) is formatted as userid!token-name (e.g. admin@pve!mcp-readonly) — this is what you pass in the Authorization header.
Token names must match /^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$/ — no spaces or special chars.
Set expire to a future Unix timestamp to enforce rotation; leave at 0 (default) for no expiration.
Use the digest param when updating tokens concurrently to prevent race conditions — not needed for a fresh create.
Tokens inherit the privileges of their parent user; they cannot exceed user-level permissions.
